records.form: Quoted and made the book's foundation
records.plain_sense_en: At the burning bush, God gives Moses His name — self-existent being itself, before any title or tribe.
records.quote_en: I AM THAT I AM ... I AM hath sent me unto you.

records.form: Quoted in the same foundational passage
records.plain_sense_en: A war-time psalm's still point: nations raging, God's people told to stop striving and know who God is.
records.quote_en: Be still, and know that I am God.

records.form: Quoted with the reference printed in the text
records.plain_sense_en: Jesus teaches prayer: faith that receives as already given, joined to forgiving others (v.25).
records.quote_en: Whatsoever things ye desire, when ye pray believe that you have received them, and ye shall have them.

records.cited_in: Your Faith Is Your Fortune (1941), Chapter 1 'Before Abraham Was'
records.form: One of the chapter's two epigraphs, printed with reference
records.plain_sense_en: The Gospel of John's prologue: before creation, the Word already was — with God, and God.
records.quote_en: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God.

records.cited_in: Your Faith Is Your Fortune (1941), Chapter 1 'Before Abraham Was'
records.form: The chapter's title verse and first epigraph, printed with reference
records.plain_sense_en: In a heated dispute in the Temple, Jesus claims a pre-Abrahamic 'I AM' — an unmistakable echo of Exodus 3:14.
records.quote_en: Verily, verily, I say unto you, before Abraham was, I AM.

records.form: Full exposition of John 3 (born from above / anothen)
records.plain_sense_en: Jesus to Nicodemus on being born from above — the Spirit moves like the wind, unseen in origin.
records.quote_en: As the wind blows where it will and you hear the sound of it but cannot tell whence it comes or whither it goes, so it is with everyone who is born of the spirit.
